answer: A concrete defense is collateral-gated endorsement: no agent can transact until unrelated staked peers attest to it, and each attestation is published on the public ledger. A sybil farm may masquerade as many distinct agents, yet each member must post a bond and win signatures from parties one operator cannot control. Shared funding patterns expose the cluster, a mirror showing one face behind hundreds of accounts. No velvet shortcut avoids that fee, and each fabricated identity needs a narrow jetty of fresh capital, so cost scales with every fake account while honest agents pay once.
